newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Benpres telecom units, Globe sign interconnection.
newsitem.headline: Benpres telecom units, Globe sign interconnection.

text.p: Two units of Benpres Holdings Corp have signed an interconnection pact with Globe Telecoms GMCR Inc, a joint venture of Ayala Corp and Singapore Telecommunications Ltd.
ICC Telecoms and Radio Communications of the Philippines (RCPI) said in a statement on Thursday the interconnection would enable subscribers direct access to subscribers of Globe.
Under government rules, ICC Telecom, an international gateway facility operator, is required to install 300,000 telephone lines.
Radio Communications provides domestic long distance services and operates public calling offices.
Globe Telecom operates a cellular mobile phone system and an international gateway facility. It is required to install 700,000 landlines.
The law requires full interconnection among all authorised private telecom carriers.
